descriptionHtml:
思路 / Approach · TC-09 All Residents Attendance Toggle (Nursing Home only) · S03 「手动加一个住户：进 All Residents 时是 Follow-up」 Add a resident by hand: lands in All Residents as Follow-up

覆盖的 UAT 步骤 / 票 AC：

  • U7 New residents, whether added by photo or by hand, land in All Residents as Follow-up (TC-06 defaults).（UAT TC-09；UAT TC-06 (by reference)；TFA-92587 AC 5；TFA-92587 How it works 5）
  • U1 All Residents is the baseline list of everyone the physician follows at the facility, and every resident in it has a working 'In Today' / '+ Today' toggle.（UAT TC-09；TFA-92587 AC 1；TFA-92587 How it works 1）

测试设计方法：主流程（happy-path） — 照 UAT / 票的原话把正常流程走一遍，该出现的都要出现。

Given Fresh physician in Nursing Home

When Tap + (Add Resident) → Full Name 'QA Resident Handadd', Unit / Room 'Oak 9', Encounter Type left as it is → 'Add to Resident Panel' → All Residents

Then The form's Encounter Type starts at Follow-up. The new resident is in All Residents with a Follow-up badge and a toggle

通过的标准（oracle，节选）：oracle.mjs: the form shows Follow-up selected and nothing else selected; All Residents lists 'QA Resident Handadd' with 'Follow-up' and no New Admission / Consult badge, and mustContain 'In Today ✓' to prove the tab; s03-chart has Follow-up selected on the new resident's own chart (U7). Whether the resident also joins Today's Visits is Q5: recorded, not judged

在哪跑：dev 单元 U75；测试方法 AGENT · 浏览器 agent；矩阵里排的车道 浏览器 agent（blocked）

S03 是我们自己编的用例号（覆盖矩阵 cases/TC-09.matrix.json 里的编号），不是 UAT 文档里的步骤号。

环境：dev — dev 部署，build e02167f（Deploy Convex，2026-10-12T18:24:27Z）；账号和地址不写进报告；run folder runs/2026-10-14-dev。

测试方法：AGENT · 浏览器 agent；辅助：PW · Playwright 脚本 — 按 cases/test-methods.json 的分类，分类说在 both 跑；来源：dev。
